lines.t: For the boy inside the man, it wasn't nobody so, listen
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
Lil' house, lil' heart on freeze
Daddy loud, mama prayin' on the knees
Learn quick, be quiet, just to please
So I buried every question, put my pain on a leash
Mirror on the wall, never answer what I'm worth
Just echoed every wound I collected from my birth
Every shout, every silence, every curse, every word
Wrote a script in my chest, turned my soul into a blur
Be tough, don't cry, don't talk, don't feel
Be strong, don't fail, keep everything sealed
So I built a little throne out of anger and steel
Told myself I'm a man, I don't need to heal
Church on a Sunday, but I lived in the dark
Heard about the cross, didn't let it hit my heart
Play good boy, but I kept all the parts that were eating me alive, tearing me apart
I've been running for the mirror, hiding all the pain
Drinking for the courage, drowning in the shame
Use our women as my banished praise, as cocaine
But the idol in the mirror's been the one that really reigns
I'm sure, can you hear me? I'm exposing every scar
Been worshiping myself and I call it who we are
Take this mask, this flow, and this prison that I built
Break me at your feet and wash away this guilt
Yeah, high school halls, heartbeat like a kid
Every girly verdict, every staring of the brick
Talking to a queen, felt like drunk enough for Cliff
So I poured up shots just to maybe get a kiss
Red Cuffs, loud room, seeing in the air
Took shots till the social anxiety was bare
If the homie said she bad, I felt like air
If they laughed at my loss, I disappeared in despair
Pouring on the screen when the nights got long
Teaching me love is just bodies and a thong
Scrolling beats, flex coaching so strong
Told myself, you're a man if they say you belong
Girls, it's trophies, not daughters of a king
Chase curves, not character, not a covenant ring
Use that beauty like a mirror to upbraid my bling
But woke up next day feelin' emptier within
I've been loopin' all these memories like a cursed playlist
Every childhood script keeps my soul in defense
Usin' money for my work for the school of love
But the idol in the mirror is the root of all my flaws
Yahushua, can you hear me? I've been frontin' as a king
But I'm just a broken boy tryin' to hide a phrasal thing
Tear these crowns down, burn the ochres that I raised
I am gone with self-worship, let your holy fire blaze
Thought they were the problem, all the women, all the friends
All the fake, all the noise, but the face in the glass
Was the snake with the poison
Striking my own soul while I smile with the boys
Blame my dad, blame the world, blamed every ex
Blame God for the chaos in the wreck
But your voice cut through, put a sword in my chest
I'm the guy that you serve, it's the self you protect
Every W of women, every nod from the crew
Only fed my addiction, kept me far from you
I chased that dude more than being a dad
Let my kids see it mad, it's not the wounds that I had
You said, look in the mirror, don't move, don't blink
If I'm not on the throne, you'll die in this drink
She is not your saiyan, the crowd's just a wave
If you don't bow now, all you build is a grave
I've been running from the middle, but you caught me in the dark
You each spoke my secret, altars lit a torch to every mark
Women were my idols, nins applause, my favorite drug
But you shattered all my statues with a crucified love
Yahushua, take this heart, make it husband, make it dad
Make it servant in the world, it's completely going mad
I renounce every idol, every loop, every lie I belong to you forever, let my own self die
Thanks for watching!
